scripts.diagrams: printf 'Generating Mermaid chart: process-flowchart.svg\n' && mmdc -p diagrams/puppeteer.json -i diagrams/process-flowchart.mmd -o public/diagrams/process-flowchart.svg -t neutral -b transparent
scripts.build: npm run diagrams && GIT_COMMIT_SHA=${GIT_COMMIT_SHA:-$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)} GIT_COMMIT_DIRTY=${GIT_COMMIT_DIRTY:-$(if git diff --quiet HEAD -- && [ -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then echo 0; else echo 1; fi)} astro build
scripts.validate: npm run format:validate && npm run lint && npm run validate:openspec && npm run typecheck && npm run infra:format:validate && npm run test:infra && npm run test:analytics-config && npm run test:consent
scripts.test:infra: node --test scripts/terraform-account.test.mjs scripts/require-approved-terraform-destroys.test.mjs scripts/parameter-store-secrets.test.mjs scripts/terraform-tracked-inputs.test.mjs scripts/terraform-reviewed-apply.test.mjs scripts/deploy-infra.test.mjs
scripts.test:a11y:full: npm run build && A11Y_FULL=1 playwright test
scripts.validate:openspec: openspec schema validate superpowers-bridge && openspec validate --all
